# Approved Manager design reference

Synthetic, read-only reference widgets used by the Manager chart and nested-form
parity tests. These four files were copied unchanged from the local approved
`experiments/manager-design-preview/lib` reference so the tests are self-contained
in a clean repository checkout. They make no network or storage calls and are
not imported by production entrypoints. See `source-sha256.json` for copy hashes.
